en.description: Digital Healing (数智疗愈): a multimodal support platform for subthreshold depression — affective assessment plus emotion-controllable music and visual generation, entered into the 2026 China International College Students' Innovation Competition.
en.ogTitle: Digital Healing (数智疗愈) | Junjie Xu
en.titleHtml: Digital Healing (数智疗愈): a Support Platform for Subthreshold Depression.
en.subtitle: A research-translation project: the lab's affective-computing work, turned into a daily support service concept for the population just below the clinical threshold.
en.authors: Project lead — Junjie Xu · team at East China Normal University
en.tldr: Subthreshold depression is widespread — especially among young adults — yet it sits below the clinical threshold where treatment resources concentrate. Digital Healing pairs multimodal affective assessment with emotion-controllable music and visual generation to offer low-threshold daily support: two product concepts (guided digital meditation, music–visual healing) on a five-layer platform, entered into the 2026 China International College Students' Innovation Competition as project lead.

sections.heading: The gap
paragraphs:
Subthreshold depression — depressive symptoms that do not reach a clinical diagnosis — affects a large population, with young adults hit hardest. It is precisely this group that the current system serves worst: clinical resources concentrate on diagnosed patients, while what is offered below the threshold is mostly self-report trackers and canned content, with no generative, personally responsive support.

The project starts from a research bet this lab has been making for years: if models can assess affect multimodally and generate emotion-controlled music and imagery, those capabilities can compose into a daily support service — not by replacing clinicians, but by catching the space between journaling and therapy.

figure.label: Fig. 1
figure.alt: Five-layer platform architecture of Digital Healing: sensing, fusion, decision, execution, and feedback layers
figure.caption: The five-layer platform architecture — from multimodal data sensing through affective fusion and decision to generation execution and feedback adjustment. From the team's 2026 competition materials.

sections.heading: The approach
paragraphs:
The platform is organized as a closed loop across five layers. Sensing collects multimodal signals; fusion forms an affective assessment; decision selects the support strategy; execution generates the intervention content; feedback closes the loop by measuring response and adjusting.

The execution layer is where the lab's research lines converge: emotion-controllable text-to-music generation and music-to-image generation with affective intent — the same alignment and preference-learning questions studied in the lab's publication line, here composed into a service pipeline rather than a benchmark.

An ethics-approved pilot study at a university psychology center (371 participants, Dec 2025 – Aug 2026) informed the requirement design: what people below the threshold actually experience, respond to, and drop.

figure.label: Fig. 2
figure.alt: Controllable text-to-music generation pipeline with emotion extraction from text
figure.caption: The emotion-controllable generation pipeline — emotion extraction from text feeding controllable music generation. From the team's 2026 competition materials.

sections.heading: The products
paragraphs:
Two concepts carry the loop to users. Guided digital meditation (数智冥想) adapts session pacing and sonic texture to the assessed state. Music–visual healing (音画疗愈) turns a user's emotional state into a personalized piece of music and matching generated imagery — support that is made for the moment rather than retrieved from a library.

The interfaces follow one principle: assessment stays ambient, generation stays legible. The user always sees what the system inferred and what it made, in plain form.

figure.label: Fig. 3
figure.alt: Product interface screens: mood home, check-in, guided meditation player, and generation report
figure.caption: The app concepts — mood home, check-in, guided meditation player, and the generation report view. From the team's 2026 competition materials.

zh.titleHtml: 数智疗愈：面向阈下抑郁人群的支持平台。
zh.subtitle: 一次研究落地：把实验室的情感计算工作，转化为服务于临床阈值之下人群的日常支持产品构想。

chips.text: 2026 中国国际大学生创新大赛 · 高教主赛道

zh.authors: 项目负责人 — 许俊杰 · 华东师范大学团队
zh.tldr: 阈下抑郁人群庞大——在青年群体中尤为突出——却恰好落在临床资源集中的阈值之下。数智疗愈把多模态情感评估与情感可控的音乐、图像生成组合起来，提供低门槛的日常支持：两个产品构想（数智冥想、音画疗愈）构建在五层平台之上，作为项目负责人参加 2026 中国国际大学生创新大赛。

stats.label: 个产品构想：数智冥想 与 音画疗愈
层平台架构：感知 → 融合 → 决策 → 执行 → 反馈
名高校心理中心伦理批准试点参与者（2025.12 – 2026.8）
年中国国际大学生创新大赛，进行中

sections.heading: 缺口在哪里
paragraphs:
阈下抑郁——未达到临床诊断标准的抑郁症状——影响的人群规模庞大，青年群体中比例尤高。而现行体系对这一群体服务最薄弱：临床资源集中在已确诊患者身上；阈值之下能得到的，多是自报式的打卡记录与千篇一律的固定内容，缺少可生成、可回应个人状态的支撑。

项目的出发点，是本实验室持续多年的一个研究判断：如果模型能够多模态地评估情感，并按情感意图生成可控的音乐与画面，这些能力可以组合成一种日常支持服务——不是替代临床，而是接住「日记与治疗之间」的那段空白。

figure.label: 图 1
figure.alt: 数智疗愈五层平台架构：感知层、融合层、决策层、执行层、反馈层
figure.caption: 五层平台架构——从多模态数据感知、情感融合与决策，到生成执行与反馈调节。取自团队 2026 年参赛材料。

sections.heading: 怎么做
paragraphs:
平台按五层闭环组织。感知层采集多模态信号；融合层形成情感评估；决策层选择支持策略；执行层生成干预内容；反馈层以响应测量收口并调节。

执行层正是实验室研究线的汇合处：情感可控的文生音乐与带情感意图的音乐生成图像——与论文线里研究的对齐、偏好学习是同一组问题，只是这里组合成服务管线，而非基准测试。

一项经伦理批准的高校心理中心试点（371 名参与者，2025 年 12 月 – 2026 年 8 月）为需求设计提供依据：阈值之下的人群到底经历什么、回应什么、在哪里流失。

figure.label: 图 2
figure.alt: 可控文生音乐生成管线：从文本中抽取情感并控制音乐生成
figure.caption: 情感可控生成管线——从文本抽取情感，驱动可控的音乐生成。取自团队 2026 年参赛材料。

sections.heading: 产品形态
paragraphs:
两个构想把闭环交到用户手里。数智冥想按评估到的状态调整冥想节奏与声音质地；音画疗愈把用户的情绪状态转化为一段专属于此刻的音乐与相配的生成画面——支持是「为这一刻生成的」，而不是从素材库里检索的。

界面遵循一条原则：评估保持无感，生成保持可读。用户始终能以直白的形式看到系统推断到了什么、生成了什么。

figure.label: 图 3
figure.alt: 产品界面：情绪首页、打卡、引导冥想播放器与生成报告
figure.caption: 应用界面构想——情绪首页、打卡、引导冥想播放器与生成报告视图。取自团队 2026 年参赛材料。
